component.name: romforge
component.summary: Identify, tidy and play your ROM collection

description.p: romforge identifies the games in your ROM folders, names and sorts them, finds their cover art, and starts each one in the right emulator.
It knows dozens of systems, from home consoles and handhelds to arcade and home computers, and has a fullscreen mode for the couch.
BIOS import: a file that only matches by name is offered only where its folders point (the right emulator or region), and never in place of a file recognised by its contents.

BIOS files are recognised by their hashes even when DATs list none, each file is listed once, and the same-named file wins its slot. Reading and importing BIOS files show their progress in the footer.
The .deb and .rpm packages (and romforge-bin) now include romforge's problem codes, so uQ's Problems page explains them.
uQ's folder and D-Bus names come from uQ's shared constants; no visible change.
Warnings and errors carry problem codes that uQ explains, and a crash leaves a report uQ lists.
Corners follow the uQ theme's radius; nothing changes outside uQ. AppStream metadata for software centres.
One romforge per session: starting it again shows the window instead of a second copy.
